A zona dos 3 Bicos encontra-se em franca expansão e valorização, beneficiando da proximidade a uma vasta oferta de comércio, serviços e equipamentos.

Serviços e restauração;

Bons acessos rodoviários;

A poucos minutos das praias de Portimão;

Próximo do centro da cidade e de todas as comodidades necessárias ao dia a dia.

T2 Refurbished in 3 Bicos - Modernity, Location and Potential for Enhancement

Excellent investment opportunity in Portimão!

We present this refurbished 2 bedroom flat, located in the prestigious and increasingly valued 3 Bicos area, in Portimão.

The flat consists of a cosy entrance hall, a practical pantry, a pleasant living room with access to a balcony, kitchen equipped with hob, oven and thermocumulator, two bedrooms with built-in wardrobes and a bathroom.

The property has undergone a refurbishment, featuring contemporary finishes and a modern aesthetic, ready to move in or monetise.

The 3 Bicos area is expanding and increasing, benefiting from the proximity to a wide range of shops, services and equipment.

In the immediate vicinity you will find:

Schools and other teaching facilities;

Supermarkets and local commerce;

Services and catering;

Good road access;

Just minutes from the beaches of Portimão;

Close to the city centre and all the amenities necessary for daily life.

The location, the T2 typology and the fact that it is completely refurbished make this property particularly interesting for those looking for an opportunity in the Algarve real estate market, whether for long-term rental, profitability or future appreciation.
